keyFindings.description: GitHub reports #2414 CONFLICTING with main 1767c9af (packages/envoy/AGENTS.md, docs/livewrite.go, docs/mutation.go). Forward merge of main (no rebase) keeping both sides; the pmdoc import fix (docstest -> crafted) while #2481 is not on main; migrations above main's highest; dispatchConnectionsPerPod = main's ConnectionsPerProcess plus this change's own; if #2480 is on main by then, its ReplaceText pmdoc.Update write covered by the close freeze and lock order.

closeMargin counts from closed_at = now() (patchIssue's transaction start, api/issue_patch.go:260), not from the commit. The same transaction then withdraws the issue's open asks (#2233), each document write waiting up to 500 ms on a flush plus the document's lock, so a keystroke observed between start+2 s and the commit is refused and dropped (websocket.go:171-173) and the browser reconnects read-only. Round-1 thread PRRT_kwDORFy7ds6xFhtn stands in part; census #1 claim is false for this path. Needs a fix and a test closing through PATCH with a slow withdrawal.

A room whose browser append storedHistoryHolds accepted keeps running behind a folded history; its cursor cannot advance and nothing asks it to catch up, so each later keystroke decodes the whole stored document under the advisory lock until a notification or settlement closes it. The comment 'is closed and reloaded (catchUpReplaced) as before' overstates. Ask the room to catch up (or mark it for reload) after an accepted append.

Contract change census omits two search hits at ff5c1919: search 1b (ErrIssueClosed) finds docs/ask_lifecycle_test.go (this PR changed it; pins ErrIssueClosed at :414); search 2 finds api/issue_close_unloadable_test.go:99 (posts /rebuild; Unaffected). Census #1 text must also match the M1 fix.

Docs that are not true: earlier-build rooms 'keep the scope' (README:640-642, AGENTS.md:885-887, running-dispatch.md:382-383) is false for documents the close or reopen writes (ask withdrawal/restore); 'a publish loads no room' (AGENTS.md:869,916, fragment) contradicted by livewrite.go:1048-1050; 'only the edit being admitted holds a connection' (README:606-607, fragment) ignores the running edit's transaction; AGENTS.md:866,868 drop 'that answer'; issue_open_test.go:310-311 says thirty seconds (45 s). PR body Size line and the 85 in thread line PRRT_kwDORFy7ds6xFhtz are stale.

Fast-follow cleanup (no behaviour): round-1 file splits still stand (room_sync.go catch-up, append gate out of pending_authors.go now 1,252 lines, livewrite.go 1,265, conditional-edit queue out of mutation.go); browser-append data carried through context (now cursor, observed, ahead); dead nil-handler branches in roomSync.register; one gateAppend without the batch wrapper; a parks(doc) helper; the compaction test should use foldThrough.
